info.name: Nigam Care API
info.description: Grows phase by phase alongside backend/src/modules — see backend/README.md. Import into Postman/Thunder Client and set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default http://localhost:4000/api/v1).

exec: // Check the running server's console (stub OTP provider) for the code, then set it below or in {{otpCode}}.

item.name: Technician
item.description: All routes require role=technician (log in via the Auth folder with identifier=9000000001, the seeded technician). See backend/src/modules/technician/ and DATA_MODEL.md's Phase 6 addendum.

item.name: Brand Admin
item.description: All routes require role=brand_admin (log in via the Auth folder with identifier=admin123@gmail.com, password=admin123 — or admin2@gmail.com for the second seeded brand, to manually verify cross-tenant isolation). See backend/src/modules/brand-admin/ and DATA_MODEL.md's Phase 7 addendum.

item.name: Super Admin
item.description: All routes require role=super_admin (log in via the Auth folder with identifier=admin123@gmail.com, password=admin123). See backend/src/modules/super-admin/ and DATA_MODEL.md's Phase 8 addendum. Finance (BillingTransaction/Revenue/PartnerPayout/GatewayTransaction) is deliberately deferred — no routes exist for it yet.

item.name: CMS
item.description: GET routes are public (no auth) — consumed by the customer/technician apps. Write routes require role=super_admin. See backend/src/modules/super-admin/cms.routes.js.

item.name: Chat
item.description: Phase 9. REST is read-only (list conversations, read message history) — sending happens over Socket.IO, not REST. No public 'create conversation' endpoint: one is auto-created when a technician accepts a job (see backend/src/modules/technician/job.service.js's acceptJob()). See backend/src/sockets/chat.gateway.js for the real-time 'join-conversation'/'send-message' events (auth via socket.handshake.auth.token, same JWT as the Authorization header) — not representable in this REST collection, covered by backend/tests/sockets.test.js instead.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('conversationId', d[0].id); } }

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Phase 9. GET /notifications includes both personally-addressed and role-broadcast (e.g. escalations) notifications. Real-time delivery pushes to the recipient's Socket.IO room on emit() — this REST surface is the fallback/history read. See backend/src/modules/notifications/.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationId', d[0].id); } }

item.name: Reviews
item.description: Phase 10. POST requires role=customer (must own the ServiceRequest). GET routes are public. PATCH /:id/respond requires role=brand_admin, cross-tenant-checked via the ServiceRequest's brand.

item.name: Dev (non-production only)
item.description: Mounted at /_dev/* only when NODE_ENV !== 'production' (app.js). Exercises pagination/validation/upload/id-generation/RBAC end-to-end — see backend/src/modules/shared/dev.routes.js.
